title: Live prefixes of a run
statement: Let $M$ be a deterministic Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, Boolean tape symbols, and state set $S$, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, and let $c$ be a configuration on $x$. If the run from $c$ is live at time $t$, then it is live at every time $u\le t$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a $k$-work-tape Turing machine over Boolean symbols with states in $S$
The run from $c$ is live at time $t$
replaced: For every machine, configuration, and time $t$ whose configuration at $t$ is live, every configuration at a time $u \le t$ is live as well, since halting is absorbing.
